title: Request
description: Internal request envelope passed from an adapter to the router or a harness.

task.description: Free-text task description, prompt, or query.

interface.description: Entry point that produced this request.

context.description: Optional pre-retrieved context (RAG hits, file excerpts, etc.).

constraints.description: Routing constraints. See policy schema in routing_rules.yaml.

metadata.description: Free-form per-call metadata (trace IDs, user info, etc.).
